label_strategy: relative — top 30th percentile attrition proxy rate per year
target_variable: attrition_proxy_rate (net teacher headcount decline / prior year count)
notes: Trained on MoE Education Statistics Bulletin data (2009-2025), primary level, provincial aggregate. attrition_count was inconsistently recorded across bulletin years and was therefore omitted; the target variable is derived from net teacher headcount decline (Ingersoll, 2001). School-level prediction is a planned future improvement contingent on access to EMIS school-level data from the Ministry of Education Permanent Secretary.
